title: Excalibane's Automation
body:
## A fictional world named Excalibane with multiplayer features.


### Cast from the mortal world,
 these adventurers found a new realm of adventure.

 ![A hobbit hole found in the mortal plane of this realm.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c769e48b60e2fc1833756d7ca0eb0ff3ec67720e.jpeg)

### The Infection
The adventures have lived for multiple decades and their age of automation had begun, but the nether's infection was spreading far.

![a view of the nether spreading into an open forest brimmed with life and  potential.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1553e4f14d2fec9efd4f25115889dcf2e79855b8_0.webp)

### Play as the new generation
in this world centuries after they left and automate you way to the future.
